verdict.rationale: Missive documents a Custom MCP feature that connects any MCP-compatible server to its AI assistant. Setup is by server URL, with no auth, bearer token, or OAuth 2.0 with custom scopes, and the assistant can then use the server's tools against internal systems. It also ships ready-made MCP integrations for Notion, Linear, Attio and Lindy.ai. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that custom MCP tool calls work in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: With custom MCP, you can connect any MCP-compatible server to Missive's AI assistant and let AI interact with your internal systems, proprietary data, or homegrown tools.
Add "Custom MCP" and enter a name and your server URL. Choose an authentication method and click Add
Choose an authentication method (none, bearer token, or OAuth 2.0, with custom scopes if your provider needs them) and click Add
Missive ships with ready-to-use MCP integrations for Notion, Linear, and Attio, plus AI automation platforms like Lindy.ai.
